spec.title: Word Search
taskFacts: Return whether a target word can be traced through a character grid.
Consecutive letters must occupy horizontally or vertically adjacent cells. A grid cell cannot be used twice within one trace. Letters may be uppercase or lowercase.
constraints: board and word contain only uppercase and lowercase English letters.
Search pruning for larger boards is an optional follow-up.

examples.explanation: The first two letters share a row and the final letter is directly below A.
The first cell would have to be reused.
